title: Issue id collision: a local session minted IS-PF-0038 already present on develop
body: During the eventing sync, our clone and develop both held IS-PF-0038 (ours: dogfood PARTIAL_SUCCESS; develop: cross-session double-claim). Issue ids are allocated from a local per-scope counter with no shared cross-session authority (unlike backlog ids), so a diverged clone can mint an id already used upstream.

rcca.root_cause: Issue ids come from a local counter (core/issues.py) with no shared authority; the backlog has one (core/id_allocator git-CAS), issues do not, so a clone diverged from develop can collide.
rcca.corrective: Kept develop's IS-PF-0038; renumbered our colliding issue to IS-PF-0043 and updated the BI-PF-1278 back-reference.
rcca.preventive: Extend the shared id authority (or a reservation/reconcile step) to issue ids; reconcile on sync.
rcca.fixed_where: data/issues (IS-PF-0038 kept; ours renumbered to IS-PF-0043)
